# Contribution and Review Record

Use one copy per substantive contribution. Public attribution is optional and requires the contributor's confirmation.

## Record identity

- Contribution ID:
- Related practice / decision / issue:
- Date received:
- Review or contribution status: Proposed / Received / Under review / Accepted in part / Accepted / Not adopted / Withdrawn
- Public attribution preference: Named / GitHub handle / Pseudonymous / Anonymous
- Attribution confirmed by contributor: Yes / No / Pending

## Contributor statement

- Preferred display name or pseudonym:
- GitHub handle (optional):
- Affiliation (optional; contributor-confirmed):
- Contact / follow-up route (optional; do not publish private contact details):

- Type: Research challenge / Evidence / Analysis / Method / Text / Design / Validation / Review / Other
- Affected claim, section, file or decision:
- Summary of work actually performed:
- Evidence, sources or reproducible reasoning:
- Limitations or conflicts of interest relevant to this contribution (optional):

## CRediT roles or equivalent

Select only roles that accurately describe the work:

- [ ] Conceptualization
- [ ] Investigation
- [ ] Methodology
- [ ] Formal analysis
- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Resources
- [ ] Writing – original draft
- [ ] Writing – review & editing
- [ ] Visualization
- [ ] Project administration
- [ ] Other (describe)

Role descriptions must be confirmed with the contributor. These labels describe contribution; they do not independently determine authorship.
